details: Bitcoin has seen a notable recovery, trading around $64,500, primarily driven by a softer-than-expected US Consumer Price Index (CPI) report that showed June inflation at 3.5%, easing concerns about aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes. This macroeconomic shift, alongside renewed institutional demand, particularly from spot Bitcoin ETFs like BlackRock's IBIT which recorded $136.48 million in inflows on July 17, has provided support. Despite a dormant whale moving $383 million in BTC, it appears to be a storage upgrade rather than a sale. Analysts are, however, divided, with some warning of a potential "July bounce, brutal August" scenario.
title: Bitcoin Recovers to $64K Amid Inflation Data and ETF Inflows

details: Leading digital asset neobank ether.fi has partnered with crypto insurance provider Nexus Mutual to secure the largest-ever Ethereum (ETH) Slashing Cover. This comprehensive protection safeguards ether.fi's validators against penalties amounting to up to 15,000 ETH, a sum that surpasses all historical ETH slashing losses combined. This move significantly enhances security for ether.fi's rapidly expanding institutional and retail user base.
title: ether.fi Secures Major ETH Slashing Protection with Nexus Mutual

details: The Arbitrum (ARB) token has experienced a decline, partly due to a significant token unlock on July 16, which released 92.65 million ARB (approximately $8.5 million) into circulation. Adding to the pressure, an $11.86 million to $18 million USDC exploit occurred on Ostium, a DeFi protocol built on Arbitrum. The exploit, stemming from manipulated oracle prices, has raised concerns about the overall security and robustness of Arbitrum's DeFi ecosystem.
title: Arbitrum (ARB) Drops Following Token Unlock and DeFi Exploit

details: Lido DAO's LDO token has seen a strong recovery and a significant price surge, with a reported 12% gain over the last 24 hours. This positive movement is largely attributed to the conclusion of an on-chain governance vote (July 15-17) for upgrades to its Curated Module v2 and Community Staking Module v3, designed to improve staking infrastructure and validator management. Additionally, ongoing Snapshot governance votes on a penalty framework for node operators are set to close on July 20, further contributing to increased trader interest and speculative activity.
title: Lido DAO (LDO) Surges on Governance Vote for Staking Upgrades

details: Morpho Midnight, a highly anticipated fixed-rate, fixed-term lending protocol, is slated for its public mainnet launch "in the coming days" after an extensive beta phase. The initial rollout will introduce a cbBTC/USDC fixed-rate, fixed-term lending market on Base. This protocol aims to revolutionize on-chain lending by externalizing risk, term, and rate to the market, marking a significant step towards attracting institutional participants to the DeFi ecosystem.
title: Morpho Midnight Fixed-Rate Lending Protocol Nears Public Launch

details: Decentralized hedge fund Numerai has announced the completion of its third strategic buyback of Numeraire (NMR) tokens, acquiring an additional $1.2 million from the open market. This latest purchase brings Numerai's total NMR buybacks over the past year to $3.2 million. The buybacks are intended to support and strengthen its machine-learning competition ecosystem, which relies on an NMR staking mechanism. The firm also reported substantial growth, with assets under management (AUM) rising from $560 million at the end of 2025 to approximately $700 million currently.
title: Numerai Completes Third Strategic NMR Token Buyback
